title: Portfolio Tenant Context Schema
description: JSON Schema for Portfolio module tenant configuration and governance context

account_id.description: Unique account identifier from auth system

plan_tier.description: Billing plan tier for portfolio access

review_cycle_weeks.description: Governance review cycle frequency in weeks (2-4 for pro, 1+ for enterprise)

max_ventures_in_review.description: Maximum ventures in active review; null for unlimited (enterprise)

allocation_model.description: Resource allocation strategy: linear (equal splits), risk-weighted (inverse risk), market-fit-weighted (proportional to market traction), or custom rules

custom_allocation_rules.description: Custom allocation rules (enterprise only); null if using standard models

risk_appetite.description: Risk tolerance level for portfolio governance decisions

kill_threshold_health_score.description: Health score threshold below which venture becomes kill candidate

scale_threshold_health_score.description: Health score threshold above which venture becomes scale candidate

pause_threshold_health_score.description: Health score threshold for pause/iterate recommendations

governance_report_recipients.description: Email addresses for governance report distribution

audit_trail_enabled.description: Enable immutable audit trail for compliance (always true for enterprise)

risk_monitoring_enabled.description: Enable continuous risk monitoring between review cycles

webhook_enabled.description: Enable webhook delivery for governance events (enterprise only)

webhook_url.description: Webhook URL for governance decision events

created_at.description: Timestamp when portfolio governance was activated

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for tenant configuration

type.description: Timestamp of next scheduled portfolio review

last_review_completed.description: Timestamp of most recent completed review
